The overall atmosphere is soothing, and the characters are charming. I can't wait to read Season 2.

This manhwa is pure comfort. Okay yes, “rich alpha poor omega” has been done a thousand times, but these main characters?? Unreasonably loveable. Every scene they’re together is soft and cute. It doesn’t feel forced, it feels like care. I love them to the point where reading them feels like I’m escaping to the top of a mountain. Fresh air in my lungs, a cold stream I can drink from without thinking twice, flower fields as my blanket, and the whole starry night sky as my roof. That’s the vibe they give me. Peaceful, but your heart’s racing.

themes.l: 원작 소설 팬인데 웹툰화가 반갑고 기대된다
